enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed with the fan running. Turn over in bed. Remain still under the blanket. Keep eyes closed. Continue sleeping until the alarm sounds.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, brushing teeth and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Push blanket aside. Stand up from the bed. Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Sit on the toilet. Stand up. Flush the toilet. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Put the toothbrush down. Turn off the tap. Open the shower screen. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wash hair and body with soap. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Wipe face and body with the towel. Hang the towel. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with the kettle and toaster, packing a lunch and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out bread, milk and eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water from the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out a bowl, a plate and a cup. Place them on the counter. Pour cereal into the bowl. Pour milk into the bowl. Take the toast out of the toaster when it pops up. Put the toast on the plate. Pick up a spoon. Sit down at the table. Eat the cereal and the toast. Drink from the cup. Stand up. Carry the dishes to the sink. Rinse the dishes. Open the refrigerator door. Take out lunch items. Place them into a lunch box. Close the lunch box. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Scroll through messages and the timetable. Put the phone into the pocket. Pick up the backpack. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by public transport to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Close the front door. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out. Check the phone for the next service. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Hold the backpack on the lap. Stand up when the stop is announced. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk to the train station. Tap the Myki card on the gate. Walk to the platform. Board the train. Sit down. Take the phone out. Look at the phone. Stand up at Clayton station. Step off the train. Tap the Myki card on the gate. Walk out of the station.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking across campus and settling into the classroom before class
enriched_activities.desc: Walk along the campus path. Carry the backpack on the shoulders. Walk past the library building. Walk up the steps. Push open the door of the classroom building. Walk into the room. Pull out a chair. Sit down at a desk. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Log in with the password. Take the notebook and pen out. Place them on the desk. Open the notebook. Wait for the lecture to start.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending business lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at the desk. Type notes on the laptop keyboard. Write notes in the notebook with the pen. Raise a hand. Ask the lecturer a question. Listen to the answer. Turn pages of the notebook. Look at the slides on the screen. Open the email on the laptop. Download the lecture slides. Stand up during the break. Walk to the water fountain. Fill the bottle. Drink water. Walk back to the desk. Sit down again. Type more notes. Talk with the classmate sitting next to me. Close the laptop lid at the end of the lecture.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus and chatting with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Put the laptop into the backpack. Zip the backpack. Walk out of the classroom. Walk to the campus canteen. Line up at the counter. Pick up a tray. Take the lunch box out of the backpack. Open the lunch box. Sit down at a table with classmates. Open the drink bottle. Eat the lunch. Talk with classmates about the assignment. Laugh. Wipe the mouth with a napkin. Close the lunch box. Stand up. Carry the tray to the return rack. Put the tray down. Walk out of the canteen with the classmates.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library and working on assignments on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the library. Walk through the turnstile. Walk to an empty desk. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Take the laptop out of the backpack. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Log in. Open the browser. Open the university portal. Download the assignment brief. Open the word processing document. Type paragraphs on the keyboard. Open the reference article. Read the article on the screen. Copy a citation. Paste the citation into the document. Scroll down the page. Take the phone out. Check a message. Put the phone down. Type more text. Save the document. Click the save icon. Stretch arms. Close the document. Close the laptop lid. Put the laptop into the backpack. Stand up. Push the chair in. Walk out of the library.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting from Monash Clayton to Chadstone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out. Check the phone. Put the phone away. Step onto the bus. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Hold the backpack. Stand up at the Chadstone stop. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk toward the shopping centre entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a retail shift at Chadstone shopping centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the store. Walk to the staff room. Put the backpack into the locker. Close the locker. Put on the name badge. Walk to the shop floor. Clock in on the terminal. Stand behind the counter. Greet a customer. Pick up a scanner. Scan the barcode of an item. Press the keys on the register. Take the payment card. Tap the card on the reader. Hand the receipt to the customer. Fold clothes on the display table. Hang garments on the rack. Walk to the stockroom. Carry a box to the shop floor. Open the box. Take out items. Place items on the shelves. Rearrange the display. Answer the phone at the counter. Write down a message on the notepad. Help a customer find a size. Walk to the fitting room. Count the items. Take the items back to the rack. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Clock out on the terminal. Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Take out the backpack. Close the locker. Walk out of the store.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from Chadstone by public transport
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out. Check the phone. Put the phone into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Put the backpack on the lap. Look out of the window. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the door. Step off the bus. Walk to the house. Open the front door. Close the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker, then washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Put the backpack down. Open the refrigerator door. Take out vegetables and meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the cupboard. Take out a pot and a pan. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Cut the vegetables with a knife on the cutting board. Put the vegetables into the pan. Stir the food with a spatula. Add salt. Turn off the induction cooker. Take a plate out of the cupboard. Scoop the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Eat dinner with chopsticks. Drink water from the cup. Stand up. Carry the dishes to the sink. Turn on the tap. Wash the dishes with a sponge. Rinse the dishes. Place the dishes on the rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Open the shower screen. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Step into the shower. Wet the hair. Apply shampoo. Rub the scalp. Rinse the hair. Apply soap to the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Walk to the sink. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth. Put the toothbrush into the cup. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Finishing university readings and assignment work on the computer at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Turn on the desk lamp. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the desk. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Log in. Open the reading PDF. Scroll through the pages. Highlight text with the cursor. Open the assignment document. Type paragraphs on the keyboard. Take the phone out. Check a message. Put the phone on the desk. Type more text. Save the document. Click the save icon. Close the document. Close the laptop lid. Stand up. Push the chair in. Turn off the desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the phone with the fan on, then going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bed. Sit down on the bed. Turn on the fan. Press the fan button. Lie down on the bed. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Scroll through the phone screen. Watch a video. Tap the screen. Put the phone on the bedside table. Turn off the bedroom light. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Go to sleep.
